plugin.name: Bids and Proposals
plugin.description: Pick relevant credentials, lawyer profiles, qualifications, service descriptions and fee templates from your firm library, check a tender's eligibility requirements and scoring criteria item by item, and generate a bid or proposal draft from your firm's Word / PPT templates with the fee quote calculated. Outward-facing materials are desensitized by default.
tool.pitch_materials_action.description: Bids and proposals: read or maintain the credentials and team library and the tender compliance matrix, calculate fee quotes, and generate a bid or proposal from Word/PPT templates (client names replaced by public descriptions in outward materials).
view.main.name: Bids and Proposals
panel.title: Bids and Proposals
panel.subtitle: Assemble bids and proposals from what the firm already has: maintain the credentials and team library, check tender requirements item by item, generate a draft from your template and edit it in the editor.
panel.lib.privacy: The library is stored on this computer only (per user on a team server) and is not shared automatically. Credentials are confidential; outward materials replace client names with their public description by default.
panel.lib.empty.credentials: No credentials yet. Add them manually or import filed and closed matters from Law Firm Management.
panel.lib.importedLawfirm: Imported {credentials} credentials and {lawyers} lawyers from Law Firm Management. Add a public description, role and summary to the imported credentials.
panel.lib.noJson: There is no library file (.json) in this project to import.
panel.lib.pickJson: Choose a library file to import
panel.field.credentials.title: Matter
panel.field.lawyers.name: Name
panel.field.lawyers.title: Title
panel.field.qualifications.name: Name
panel.field.services.title: Title
panel.field.quotes.name: Template name
panel.hint.credentials.client: Visible inside the firm only. Outward materials never show this name.
panel.hint.credentials.clientAlias: Replaces the client name in outward materials, e.g. "a provincial state-owned construction investment group".
panel.hint.credentials.lawyers: Separate names with commas; use the names in the lawyer list.
panel.hint.credentials.tags: E.g. SOE, retainer, construction. Used for automatic selection.
panel.hint.services.content: Several paragraphs, one per line. Fills the service plan placeholder of the template.
panel.quote.ratesHint: One per line: title=rate, e.g. Partner=2800.
panel.quote.label: Item
panel.quote.title: Title
panel.tender.heading: Tender document
panel.tender.pick: Choose the tender document in this project
panel.tender.hint: Step one: AI reads the tender section by section and lists eligibility requirements and scoring criteria, each with its source text. Step two: each item is checked against the credentials and team library. You can change any conclusion; edited items are never overwritten by a new check. Charged to your Credits.
panel.tender.extracted: Extracted {n} requirements. Review them, then click "Check against library".
panel.tender.truncated: The tender is long and only its first part was read; add the remaining requirements manually.
panel.tender.confirmReplace: Extracting again replaces the current matrix, including conclusions you edited. Continue?
panel.tender.matched: Check finished: {met} met, {partial} partly met, {missing} missing.
panel.tender.matchFailed: {n} batches returned no usable result; click "Check against library" again to fill them in.
panel.tender.digestTrimmed: The library is large; {n} entries weakly related to the requirements were not sent to the AI.
panel.gen.heading: Generate a bid or proposal
panel.gen.samplesWritten: Sample templates added to the project: {paths}. Restyle them in the editor; see the plugin notes for placeholder syntax.
panel.gen.templateHint: A template is an ordinary Word / PPT file in the project with placeholders such as {{client.name}} or {{credentials.title}}; list fields in a table row repeat that row.
panel.gen.outward: Outward material (client names replaced by public descriptions)
panel.gen.outwardHint: Outward files are checked for real client names from the library after generation. If you turn this off you get an internal version with real client names; do not send it out.
panel.gen.missingAlias: These credentials have no public description; the client will show as "a client": {list}
panel.gen.polish: Ask AI to check the layout
panel.gen.polishPrompt: Please create a presentation review of "{path}" page by page: keep the firm template's style and every fact and figure unchanged, add no credentials or data, fix text overflow, overlaps, alignment and spacing, check each rendered page and report back.
panel.gen.leaks: Warning: real client names from the library still appear in the file: {list}. Remove them in the editor before sending.
panel.gen.noLeaks: Checked: no real client name from the library appears in the file.
panel.gen.internal: Internal version with real client names. Do not send out.
panel.gen.unknown: Unrecognised placeholders were left as they are: {list}
panel.sens.heading: Desensitization check
panel.sens.hint: Uses the File Desensitization engine to find phone numbers, ID and bank card numbers and the library's real client names; lawyer and company names are left alone.
panel.sens.none: Nothing sensitive was detected (this does not guarantee there is none).
panel.err.upgrade: This version of AI WorkDeck is too old. Please update.
panel.err.permission: You do not have permission for this action.
panel.err.generic: The action did not complete. Please try again later.
panel.err.failed: The action did not complete. Please try again later.
panel.err.quota: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
panel.err.not_signed_in: Please sign in to AI WorkDeck.
panel.err.bad_library: The library file is not in the right format.
panel.err.library_too_large: The library is too large to save. Delete entries you no longer use.
panel.err.matrix_too_large: The matrix is too large to save.
panel.err.quote_rate_missing: The fee template has no hourly rate for "{detail}".
panel.err.quote_empty: A fee template needs at least one fee item.
panel.err.bad_amount: Invalid amount or number: {detail}. Use digits only, e.g. 300000 or 2800.50.
panel.err.template_too_large: The template file is too large.
panel.err.template_invalid: The template is not a valid Word / PPT file.
panel.err.item_missing: A selected entry is no longer in the library. Select again.
panel.err.lawfirm: Could not read Law Firm Management data. Make sure the Law Firm Management plugin is installed and enabled; it works in the desktop app only.
panel.err.emptyTender: The tender has no readable text. Run OCR on scanned files first.
panel.err.noRequirements: No eligibility requirements or scoring criteria were found. Check that this is the tender document.
panel.gen.overflow: The tables on slide {list} have many rows and may still run off the slide after the rows were shortened. Check them in the editor or select fewer entries.
panel.hint.credentials.title: Outward materials use the matter name as is; if it contains a short form of the client name, rewrite it so the client is not identifiable.
